tools.name: postalform.get_workflow_state
tools.description: Return the current PostalForm home workflow state, including step, addresses, delivery settings, and submit readiness.

tools.name: postalform.go_to_step
tools.description: Jump to a specific workflow step by index (0-6) or step id (upload, recipient_address, recipient_name, sender_name, sender_address, review, submission).

tools.name: postalform.set_delivery_options
tools.description: Update delivery and print options on review: color, double-sided, mail class, certified, and certified electronic return receipt.

go_to_review.description: When true (default), move to review step if the workflow has required sender/recipient details.

tools.name: postalform.set_pdf_from_data_url
tools.description: Set the workflow PDF using a data:application/pdf;base64 URL, then optionally advance to the recipient-address step.

data_url.description: A data URL formatted as data:application/pdf;base64,...

file_name.description: Optional PDF file name. Defaults to uploaded-document.pdf.

advance_to_recipient_step.description: When true (default), move the workflow to step 1.

tools.name: postalform.set_recipient_details
tools.description: Update recipient name and/or recipient address in the home workflow. Can optionally advance to the next relevant step.

address.description: Recipient address object with text, optional description, optional id, and optional type.

advance_to_next_step.description: When true (default), move to the next workflow step after updates.

tools.name: postalform.set_sender_details
tools.description: Update sender name and/or sender address in the home workflow. Can optionally advance to the next relevant step.

address.description: Sender address object with text, optional description, optional id, and optional type.

advance_to_next_step.description: When true (default), move to the next workflow step after updates.

tools.name: postalform.submit_order
tools.description: Submit the current order draft for checkout using the same validation and confirmation behavior as the review button.

request_confirmation.description: When true (default), require visible user confirmation before submission.
